name: Hawaii Steel LLC
old_description: Hawaii Steel is the go-to source for structural steel construction in Hawaii. Our team of experienced professionals specializes in commercial and industrial projects, using the latest in state-of-the-art equipment and technology to ensure the highest quality of work.
about:
Hawaii Steel LLC operates from Kapolei on the island of Oahu, Hawaii, serving clients throughout the Hawaiian Islands. The company provides structural steel fabrication and erection services for commercial and industrial construction.

The firm specializes in structural steel construction, including welding, pre-engineered metal building assembly, custom fabrication, design-build delivery, and miscellaneous metals work. Its capabilities cover the full project lifecycle from design through erection, using modern equipment to meet project specifications.

Hawaii Steel works primarily with general contractors on commercial and industrial projects. Notable projects include the BYU Hawaii Math & Science Building, Solomon Elementary School, East Kapolei Elementary School, the Safeway at Ho'okele Shopping Center, Turtle Bay Resort exterior renovations, the JFC Hawaii Warehouse, and the Diamond Head Theater.

The company emphasizes on-time, on-budget delivery and holds AISC certification (Certification Number C-00025171), reflecting a commitment to quality standards in steel fabrication and erection. With years of industry experience, the team tackles complex steel projects across the islands and cites a focus on customer satisfaction.
